changelog: Targets Jellyfin 12.4 and .NET 10; hardens discovery matching and audit checkpoint recovery. New-source writes remain disabled by default. See CHANGELOG.md for validation and remaining runtime limits.
description: Finds TV-series themes through curated stable-ID sources, ThemerrDB, AnimeThemes, Plex, and optional YouTube/SoundCloud/Bilibili discovery; provides a non-writing whole-library audit of candidate matches before automated installation is enabled.
name: Theme Music Finder
overview: Finds missing TV series theme music and saves it as theme.mp3.
